trainingSource: FAO EcoCrop environmental requirement profiles via OpenCLIM
labelType: mechanistic screening teacher; not observed farm yield

gate.rule: Held-out crop-profile coverage must be within 2 percentage points of both nominal levels.

conditionalUncertaintyCalibration.condition: deterministic seasonal and establishment suitability are both greater than zero
conditionalUncertaintyCalibration.activeMethod: tree-disagreement-normalized split conformal on active validation examples
conditionalUncertaintyCalibration.inactivePolicy: zero radius because the deterministic ceiling fixes the deployed score at zero

gate.rule: Active held-out coverage must be within 2 percentage points of both nominal levels.

selectionEvidence: Fitting 120 scenarios per training crop with 70 Extra Trees improved MAE and p90 error on all seven locked confirmation/final crop-profile splits while retaining the exact v0.8 validation/test rows and reducing artifact size; see evaluation/training-density-validation-v0.9.json.

boostedCandidate.reason: Held-out crop-profile MAE was worse than the selected Extra Trees estimator.

promotionGate.rule: Refuse artifact promotion unless held-out fidelity and conformal coverage meet every frozen production threshold.
